name: Rate
summary: Capture or display a score as a row of stars.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-rate> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; selection and hover-preview toggle a class on persistent star nodes so the fill animates. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Filled
spec.value: color-primary #E70E68 (Vivid Pink), the old kit's rounded 20-box star glyph

spec.label: Half
spec.value: filled overlay clipped to 50% at any x.5 (allow-half); precision="exact" clips to the exact fraction instead

spec.label: Character
spec.value: any DS icon by name via `icon` (outline, brand-tinted)

spec.label: Numbers
spec.value: character="number": cells 1..count, 32×32 shrinking to 24 so 10 fit a 360px phone (sm 24×24), radius 8 (sm 6), gap 4; empty is a 1px gray-40 outline with the number in text-default 14/600 (sm 12), filled is color-primary with a white number; whole steps only

spec.label: On a deck
spec.value: surface="deck": empty glyph and cell outline --aha-deck-stroke-chip (the deck ink at 20%, as radio and checkbox outlines), number --aha-deck-ink, number on a fill --aha-deck-accent-ink, focus ring --aha-deck-ink; filled stays color-primary, which applyDeck sets to the deck accent. No deck tokens: the default values

props.name: count
props.desc: Number of stars (DS V3 name; `max` is an alias)

props.name: allow-half
props.desc: Half-star selection — the left half of a star scores n−0.5

props.name: allow-clear
props.desc: Click the current value again to clear to 0

props.name: icon
props.desc: Custom character: a DS icon name (e.g. system-heart-straight) drawn instead of the star

props.name: character
props.desc: number draws numbered cells 1..count instead of a glyph (a numbers-only rating). Whole steps: allow-half and precision="exact" are ignored. Wins over icon

props.name: size
props.desc: sm draws 16px stars with a 2px gap (default 24px, gap 4)

props.name: precision
props.desc: Display-only (needs readonly): fills the last star by the exact fraction, so 4.8 fills 80% of the fifth star instead of rounding to a half

props.name: surface
props.desc: the surface the Rate sits on. deck = an audience or canvas deck: the empty glyph, the number cell and the focus ring follow the --aha-deck-* ladder that applyDeck (audience) or applyDeckTokens write, so empty stars read on light, dark and coloured decks. With no deck tokens on the page it renders exactly like the default

whenToUse.when: a subjective score on a small fixed scale — a review, a difficulty, satisfaction
a numbered score (1 to 10) the respondent reads as a number rather than a glyph
picking one labelled option from a few, not a magnitude
a continuous value across a wide range

opinion.note: Keep the scale small (5 is the norm). Pair with a short label — 'Rate this session' — and show the chosen value nearby for confirmation.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — from the DS V3 `rate` component-set: count (default 5), value + hover preview, allow-half, disabled/read-only display, allow-clear, and a custom character (any DS icon by name). Filled star uses color-primary (#E70E68, Vivid Pink under the colour rules); empty uses gray-40 (#E3E3E3), the neutral border value. Half fill clips a persistent overlay glyph to 50%. Motion via the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes — no subtree rebuild on selection or hover.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: hover preview to cursor (half-precise with allow-half)
custom character via icon= (DS icon by name)
surface=deck: empty glyph on the deck ladder, default unchanged with no deck tokens

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe holds value=3 so filled + empty stars both exist; each star is an empty base glyph + a clipped filled overlay. Asserts the filled overlay resolves to the pink (color-primary), the empty base is gray-40, the star is 24×24, and the probe renders exactly 5 stars.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-rate[data-probe]');var sr=el.shadowRoot;var on=sr.querySelector('.star.on .fill svg path');var off=sr.querySelector('.star:not(.on) .base svg path');var any=sr.querySelector('.star .base svg');var so=on?getComputedStyle(on):null;var sf=off?getComputedStyle(off):null;var sa=any?getComputedStyle(any):null;return{filledFill:so?so.fill:null,emptyFill:sf?sf.fill:null,starW:sa?sa.width:null,starH:sa?sa.height:null,count:sr.querySelectorAll('.star').length};})()
